title: Entrol showcases Bell 429 simulator at European Rotors 2026, completes first full flight simulator
summary: The full flight simulator is modelled on the Leonardo AW139.
body_markdown:
[entrol](https://entrol.net/) , the manufacturer of EASA and FAA certified FFS, FTD and FNPT flight simulators, will exhibit at European Rotors 2026 from December 1 to 3 at European Rotors Lyon (France), Hall 4.


Attendees will be able to experience hands-on flight demonstrations in entrol’s Bell[429](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/429) simulator at Static Display 758 and meet the company’s commercial and technical team at Booth 716.


The company arrives in Lyon having reached a major engineering milestone: The completion of its first full flight simulator (FFS), modelled on the Leonardo[AW139](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/leonardo/aw139) helicopter for Italian operator Air Corporate.


European Rotors offers the rotorcraft community an early opportunity to discuss the development of this first high-fidelity device directly with the team behind it.


**Hands-on flight testing at Static Display 758 and FFS insights at Booth 716**


Throughout the three-day exhibition, operators, training organizations, and aviation professionals can visit entrol across two dedicated areas:


- **Static Display 758 – Bell[429](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/429) demonstration simulator:** attendees can step into the cockpit of entrol’s Bell[429](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/bell/429) demonstration unit. Configured with an LED cylindrical visual system and a dedicated vibration system, the simulator allows pilots to experience realistic helicopter handling cues and mission environments on the show floor.
- **Booth 716 – Full Flight Simulator (FFS) program:** entrol’s specialists will be available to share firsthand insights into the engineering and capabilities of its first FFS, helping operators and flight academies evaluate how full-motion simulation can integrate into their training programs.


Entrol Photo


**First[AW139](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/leonardo/aw139) Full Flight Simulator (FFS) completed for Air Corporate**


entrol’s first FFS, an[AW139](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/leonardo/aw139) , has now been completed at the company’s headquarters in Madrid, where Air Corporate’s flight crew has already flown and tested the simulator.


Developed using entrol’s in-house hardware and software architecture, the[AW139](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/leonardo/aw139) FFS features:


- An exact replica of the[AW139](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/leonardo/aw139) cockpit operated by Air Corporate.
- A six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) motion platform for full-motion flight cueing.
- An ENWALL LED visual system with LED floor, powered by ENVISION, entrol’s proprietary image generator, including customized mission databases for aerial firefighting, SAR, EMS, and offshore operations.
- A dedicated debriefing station.


This milestone strengthens the ongoing collaboration between both organizations: Air Corporate already operates entrol[H125](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h125) and[H145](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h145) FTD Level 3 simulators, and in March 2025 announced the acquisition of an[H145](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/airbus/h145) FFS, scheduled for installation in 2027.


“Arriving at European Rotors with our first Full Flight Simulator completed is a very special moment for entrol. It is the result of our entire team’s dedication and the trust placed in us by a customer like Air Corporate. We invite operators and training centers considering an FFS to visit us at Booth 716 and learn about the project firsthand,” said Luis Olarte, CEO and founder of entrol.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by entrol.*
